owning.title: Owning teams
owning.label: Teams

hintNone.process: This process belongs to the whole instance: roles and the access list below decide who may do what.
hintNone.platform: This platform belongs to the whole instance: roles and the access list below decide who may do what.
hintNone.service: This service belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.application: This application belongs to the whole instance (or to the teams of its services): everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.system: This system belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, administrators and its owners change it.
hintNone.record: This document belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; roles and its owner decide who changes and approves it.
hintNone.credential: This entry belongs to the whole instance: roles and its owners decide who sees and changes it.
hintNone.monitor: This monitor belongs to the whole instance: roles and its access list decide who may do what.
hintNone.dashboard: This dashboard belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; its owner and administrators change it.
hintNone.ticket: This ticket reference belongs to the whole instance: everybody signed in sees it; designers, operators and its responsibles change it.
hintNone.site: This site belongs to the whole instance: roles and the access list decide who may see and manage it, its hierarchy and its assets.
hintNone.contract: This data contract belongs to the whole instance: everybody who works in Steward sees it; operators test it, designers change it.
hintNone.platform_identity: No owning team: only administrators and the access list below may use this identity.

hintOwned.process: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this process. Everyone else sees it only through the access list below; administrators always, auditors may view.
hintOwned.platform: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this platform. Everyone else sees it only through the access list below; administrators always.
hintOwned.service: Only members of these teams see this service (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.application: Only members of these teams see this application (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.system: Only members of these teams see this system (designers among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.record: Only members of these teams see this document (editors and approvers among them change and approve it), besides its owner, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.credential: Only members of these teams see this entry (designers and operators among them change it), besides its owners, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.monitor: Members of these teams have their roles in the team on this monitor. Everyone else sees it only through its access list; administrators always, auditors may view.
hintOwned.dashboard: Only members of these teams see this dashboard, besides its owner, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.ticket: Only members of these teams see this ticket reference (designers and operators among them change it), besides its responsibles, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.site: Only members of these teams see this site with its hierarchy and assets (designers among them manage it), besides those on its access list, administrators and auditors.
hintOwned.contract: Only members of these teams see this data contract (operators among them test it, designers change it), besides administrators and auditors. A failed test notifies them.
hintOwned.platform_identity: Members of these teams who design or operate may use this identity; everyone else only what its access list gives.

defaultsSite: Default role rights apply (everyone who works in Steward sees the site, designers manage it). Add entries to restrict access to specific users, teams or roles.

helpSite.view: See the site, its hierarchy, buildings and assets

restrictedIdentity: Listed: besides administrators and members of its owning teams, only the subjects below may use this identity – and only if they may use the platform.
defaultsIdentity: Closed: only administrators and members of its owning teams (designers, operators) may use this identity. Add the users, teams or roles that need it.

helpIdentity.use: Use this identity in runs, schedules, triggers, monitors and MCP (needs “use” on the platform as well)
